name: 02-litter-takeaway
prompt:
Two-layer hand-drawn 2D illustration, 16:9. Clean flat fills describe the rendering technique, not pristine
physical condition. Apply the specified story-driven wear, stains and damage using restrained hard-edged shapes;
preserve identity and the established style. Characters and props use flat fills, at most two or three
hard-edged tones per object, one consistent dark grey-blue outline weight; no gradients, airbrush, soft shading,
paper texture or film grain on characters or props. The environment is a carefully painted background and may use
restrained gradients, ambient occlusion, material texture, depth and motivated lighting appropriate to the scene. Show a visible
light source, its falloff, contact shadows and cast shadows. Keep character shadows hard-edged. Use the episode's
palette and light plan; do not impose a global colour grade. Avoid empty wall plus person, featureless flat
backgrounds, and frames made of only two large colour fields. Keep the location and viewing direction readable.
No text, letters, numbers, subtitles, watermark, logo, UI, comic symbols or sound-effect marks.

Close environmental evidence shot, 50mm, camera 70cm above the floor looking obliquely down under the edge of the same blue-grey sofa. A severely overflowing rectangular grey cat litter tray occupies middle left. Recognizable irregular dark brown dried cat feces, urine-caked litter clumps and scattered granular litter cover the floor around it. Right foreground ruptured translucent takeaway bags, crushed greasy food boxes with rotting leftovers, dark spilled broth trapped under plastic, tangled clumps of shed fur stuck in wet grime. One cardboard cat nest has a soaked collapsed base adhered to the floor. A few small brown cockroaches with visible antennae crawl along the wall junction, normal insect size. The sofa leg and broad floor stains convey real scale. Window edge visible upper right provides cool daylight and contact shadows. The filth must read as feces, caked litter, greasy food and hair rather than generic brown rubble. Detailed yet graphic hand-drawn treatment, disgusting lived-in domestic neglect, no gore.

Colors and lighting: Overcast morning, visible window at rear right, 6000K cool-neutral daylight, readable midtones; dirt is local, no overall brown or green filter. Palette: #E1E4DE, #99AAA7, #655B50, #7D929C, #292D2E. Accent: one muted brick-red takeaway bag, no other saturated patches. Allow a secondary environmental hue; keep subtle neutral, blue-grey and sea-green differences. No people, human body parts, anthropomorphic characters, living cats, dead animals, text, logos, borders, split panels, photographic rendering, 3D rendering, paper grain or cinematic darkness. Keep key evidence above bottom fifth; bottom fifth may contain nonessential continuing clutter.
